title: Loss Landscape Topology Reveals Why Simple Baselines are Competitive at 3D Point Cloud Segmentation Under Class Imbalance
mechanism: Systematic comparison of 11 imbalance methods vs plain CE: CE stays within 0.8-3.3 mIoU; poorly tuned specialised methods can degrade badly.
adaptation: Benchmark rule: include tuned plain CE(+Dice) as the control and report tuning budget per method; prior that loss-only fixes give small gains.
min_experiment: No training run; fold into benchmark protocol (equal tuning budget per imbalance method).
evidence: R: 3D point clouds, imbalance 641:1 and 56:1, two architectures: CE within 0.8-3.3% mIoU of specialised methods.
